changelog: Onboarding asks what to call you before the first device, and that name becomes the one the app shows and the nickname on your account.
Notifications rows show a time again — the device never sends one for a live alarm, so the app remembers when it first saw it.
Feedback is the handoff's sheet now: title, two outlined fields and a filled Send Feedback button.
Android: the keyboard no longer covers bottom-anchored fields and buttons — the inset now comes from the system, which stopped resizing the window when the app went edge-to-edge.
The Bluetooth permission and Bluetooth-off screens sit where the handoff puts them; the permission screen drops the extra retry button the design does not have.
Android: nothing white can show under the home indicator — the navigation bar, the WebView and the page root are all pinned dark.
Device Monitor's bell only shows its red dot when Notifications actually has something to show.
